name: 20BN-Something-Something-V2
description: The 20BN-Something-Something-V2 dataset is a video action benchmark designed for learning fine-grained physical object interactions and visual common sense. It contains 220,847 short video clips showing humans performing predefined physical actions with everyday objects across 174 action classes (such as 'Pushing something so that it falls off the table'). Sourced via crowdsourced acting and hosted by Qualcomm, it tests temporal reasoning rather than static scene recognition.
